xerj search — retrieve code from a running XERJ node (reference coding, no scripts) Default ranking is lexical: it matches the words you typed, and it is not a neural reading of the code. USAGE: xerj search [OPTIONS] "" OPTIONS: --url node endpoint (default $XERJ_URL or http://localhost:9200) --prefix

one index prefix to search (default "ax" — what `xerj autoindex` writes); no comma lists --api-key Authorization (or $XERJ_API_KEY; --insecure nodes need none) -k number of passages to return (default 5). A non-number is a usage error, not a silent default --full max characters of each passage to print (default 600) --json print the raw response instead of formatted passages EXAMPLE: xerj --insecure -d ./.xerj-data & # a node, running xerj autoindex ref/sled # index once xerj search "fsync the WAL segment on rotation" # one line in, a passage out SEE ALSO: xerj def exact go-to-definition when you already know the name When the autoindex catalog records a folder on this machine for --prefix and a file there is newer than the last index, or an indexed file has been removed, the command prints the last index time and a reindex command, then prints the passages. The check stats at most 4096 entries, stops after 100ms, and skips hidden and ignored paths.
